description:
Man in the Moon
Hand that matches lower leg is placed below tab
Other hand is posting arm
Remove top leg and then lower leg
Head is always on one side of the hoop and body on the other side of the hoop
Booty slides to the side which allows the posting arm to be placed
progressions:
Removing one leg at a time will allow student to stabilize without all weight dropping at one time.  
Both legs come off the hoop at the same time for a drop.

description:
Dragonfly
Knees to chest
roll belly to hoop
block with top of ankles.

Figure Four
Pull up
During pull up, switch hand of leg that is crossed over to palms toward you
Come through hoop
Leg that originally crossed over becomes arabesque leg
progressions:
Stop in lady in the moon (level 1)
Continue through without stopping

name: fan kick to butt shelf
description:
Dragonfly
One hand on belly
one hand on bottom posting again bar
Fankick opposite leg of posted arm across and around the hoop (like clock) as you scoot the booty off and come into buttshelf.
teaching_cues: Posting against the bar is crucial because it takes some of the weight off your butt, allowing for a smoother transition.

name: Candlestick Entrance
description:
Both hands on one side of the hoop. 
Engage back and draw shoulders away from ears. 
Pull up so hanging from hands. 
One leg on either side of hoop. 
One leg goes in hoop, other goes in and crosses for candlestick pose.

From standing on the bottom bar
both hands to one strap
leg matching what hands are on strap
threads through to the other side of the hoop
other leg crossed over that ankle (bar between ankles)
walk hands down to Candlestick.

Dragonfly
use lower abs to bring knees towards chest 
legs over the bottom bar to Cuddle

Dragonfly
Lean back over bar with belly to the ceiling
Leg of posting arm hooks at hip crease on bottom bar
Other leg straightens under tab of opposite side of bar

Bring arm around and put bar under armpit
Externally rotate leg on bar to bring out

Buttshelf
Bring one leg in front of the hoop
Keep legs pushing toward the hoop both front and back.
safety_cues: CANNOT let go of hands in faux buttshelf.

description:
Wine Glass
hand under Wine Glass leg
invert to Faux Butt Shelf

Seated on bottom bar. 
One foot bar is at toe pit. 
Pull up to Flamingo.
modifications: Dorsiflexion of the ankle/foot can make this challenging if mobility is not achievable.

name: Flip in
description:
Hands palms toward or away (most people do palms toward). 
Engage biceps and upper back. 
Bring legs off ground and thru hoop while bringing hips to the bar. 
End in hip hang.
modifications: This move is easier sometimes when done from a higher hoop.

description:
Hip Hang Twisted V
Front leg (closest to hoop) threads between hoop and back leg 
back leg comes down into Hock Hang

Wine Glass
hands to top bar palms away
Pull up
Wine Glass leg slides behind hoop while free leg hooks on bar.
Leg in front of hoop traces to opposite side for inside lion.

Man in Moon
Hand of foot that is on top pulls you up slightly so you can move your legs
Bottom hand can reach around booty and post into hoop if need be
Bottom leg comes outside of the hoop towards you
Top leg goes toward hoop
Ends in Inside lion

Wine Glass
hand under Wine Glass leg
invert to Faux Butt Shelf
Wine Glass leg traces the front of the hoop into a low Inside Lion.

Use top hand to pull up while bottom hand posts against bar. 
Bring legs back into man in moon configuration.

name: Staddle Back Side Entrance
description:
Stand to front side of hoop.  
Whatever side of the body is closest to the hoop, that hand is on top in a cross grip.  
Straddle Back and leg closest to the hoop hooks in an outside knee hook.

name: Staddle Back Side Entrance
description:
Stand to front side of hoop.  
Whatever side of the body is closest to the hoop, that hand is on top in a cross grip.  
Straddle Back and leg closest to the hoop hooks in an outside knee hook.

Wine Glass, 
hands to top bar in baseball grip. 
Wine glass leg pushes down as you use your hands to pull you up. 
Head comes to other side of hoop. 
Should end in popsicle on same leg as wine glass.

Hip Hang
One Leg straight towards floor, other bent in front of straight leg
Opposite arm from bent leg grabs bent foot/ankle.  Other arm is holding onto the bar. (or no hands and drop to KH)
Flip forward to knee hook.
Take hand off bar and grab foot/ankle of free leg (If having trouble grabbing other foot, crunch forward to grab foot, then invert and arch back.)

progressions: Can do multiple in a row by continuing to drive leg thru middle and motorcycle hands.

name: Russian Roll Entrance
description:
One leg in hoop and hook. 
Other leg planted on ground. 
Hands either palms away or palms toward you. 
Kick leg thats on the ground thru hoop, bring chest up and motorcycle hands to get around hoop.

name: Chest to Bar Entrance
description:
Both hands on one side of the hoop. 
Engage back and draw shoulders away from ears. 
Pull up so hanging from hands. 
Chest should be very close to bar. 
Can make multiple shapes here (pencil, knees bent behind, one leg straight and one leg bent). 
Get into hoop by putting one leg in and climbing up that side.

name: Half pull up to seated
description:
Both hands on top bar. 
Engage shoulders and upper back to pull butt up to hoop and into seated.
progressions:
Can add slight jump if need be.
Deadhang, then full pull up

name: Hip Hang Figure 4
description:
Flip in to Hip Hang then Hip Hang Figure 4.  
Hook Figure 4 knee on bar.  
Press down with knee hang leg and use the arm the matching arm to reach up with big sit up to grab top of bar or side of the bar matching the hand that is grabbing.

name: Hoop Flip Pull up to Seated
description:
Can start by flipping the hoop or spinning which will flip the hoop.  
Pull Up, legs wide, and slide down onto bar.

name: Stag Leg Jumps
description:
Starts from standing with long arm hang and knees bent in Stag legs (similar to a back lunge)  then jump to opposite side of room
Repeat and then pull up to seated.

name: Vine Crawl
description:
Both hands on one side of the hoop. 
One leg goes in hoop. 
Climb hands up to top bar and bring leg in to come to seated.

Legs come around to hook in double knee hook 
pull up to seated.

name: Genie Sit
description:
Hip Hang
one hand on either side of hips. 
Slowly take hips out of hoop 
cross legs on way down as you release your short arm grip.

name: Pike Hip Hang Dismount
description:
Hip Hang, one hand on either side of hips. 
Slowly bring hips off hoop, keeping legs straight in pike position. 
Engage arms and abs to make decent more controlled and slower.

name: Straddle Back Exit
description: From straddle back, slowly bring hips to floor by engaging core and arms.
progressions: May keep legs in straddle or move them into pike

name: Wine Glass Drop
progressions:
From Wine Glass, both hands palms away on top bar, head to the other side of the hoop, both hands grab belly of hoop on opposite side, drop to SKH.
From Wine Glass, Wine Glass hand grabs top bar palms away, free leg hand grabs belly of hoop on opposite side, drop to SKH.
From Wine Glass, free leg hand grabs top bar palms away, Wine Glass hand grabs belly of hoop on opposite side, drop to SKH.

name: Toe Kisses from Top Bar
description:
From seated on bottom bar, 
put hands between tabs. 
Engage back and arms and slowly lower body off of hoop and down. 
While lowering, kicking legs out as though you are walking.

name: Wine Glass Flip Out
description:
From Wine Glass, 
hand under Wine Glass leg and backflip to the floor.

name: Wine Glass Backflip
description:
From Wine Glass, 
hand under Wine Glass leg 
backflip to the floor.

name: Straddle Back Entrance
description:
From standing, crouched, or seated on mat, bring legs out to straddle and hips up to the bar. 
Stack hips, torso, chest, and shoulders. 
Keep chest up and thru hands.

Wine Glass
Hands at Hoop Belly
Free Leg from Back to Front of Hoop
Lift Body Off Hoop (inside leg thigh only will be touching hoop)
modifications: Hands higher than belly if need more booty clearance.
